title: THE SECTOR MAP CARD, SECOND PASS
why: The critic scored the sector map card 3 of 5 (up from 2) and named what was left: labels crowding each other and touching the frame, zone names as loud as the extraction names, a contracts list with uneven rows and a bold reward that outweighed the contract name, two spaces in the weather line, a finished contract dimmed, a grey perimeter wall that read as a second frame, saturated ground blocks, and no close hint for the pad. This pass keeps labels 10 px off the frame and 5 px off every mark, sets zone names a size smaller and not bold, gives the contracts an even 76 px row with the reward in the label type and the progress bar under every counted row, uses one separator in the weather line, puts a close hint with its key at the right of the footer, and calms the wall, water, hot ground and cache colours. His Q6 (4 of 5 everywhere), Q7 and Q43.
now: The sector map is calmer: quieter zone names, labels clear of the frame, an even contracts list and a close hint.
